title: Plurai bench manifest — the bench's typed self-description and the checks that prove it

language.description: from the bench's files, never the config's free text: node when the workdir holds bridge/bridge.map.json, else python (claude-skill is the analysis's)

shape.description: what plurai.config.yaml DECLARES; `undeclared` is the absence, never a default

dispatch_shape.description: what the runner will DRIVE it as: the declaration, else dialog. Checks key on this, never on `shape`

entry.description: the entry point the analysis named, e.g. initiateNextTurn

entry_symbol.description: the typed entry the smoke witnesses: the function whose start means the agent's turn logic ran, or external when it runs outside the harness interpreter. Checked by bench_manifest.py (this walker reads no oneOf)

launched_by.description: the harness itself starts this process (a child it hands its pinned environment)

module_path.description: agent module dir, relative to the repo root

smoke_inputs.description: pipeline, or mocked dialog whose turn 1 opens a record by a request key: one smoke_pipeline pass per entry on the local mock (absent on a pipeline bench, smoke_pipeline is not_run); smoke_turn Inits with the FIRST entry's world, its inputs merged over the planted request keys

credentials.description: true when the tool carries a credentials block — never probed

render_actions.description: client-side verbs the model emits; mirrors plurai.config.yaml render_actions, with the arg contract the scan observed or read

args.description: arg name -> JSON-schema-ish type string or object

arg_classes.description: arg path -> closed-set fact subject it must draw from (feeds the typed-facts work; unread until the checker supports it)

sources.description: paths relative to the repo root

host_effects.description: live tools that act on the host or reach an external service (scripts/host_effects.py); each runs for real only on a grant in .host_effects_consent

host_effects_map_sha256.description: sha256 of the map's `writes:` facts host_effects was derived from (rewire_agentforce.map_writes_sha256); the hosted rewire refuses up when it is not the current map's

host_effects_tools_sha256.description: sha256 of the plurai.config.yaml `tools:` block host_effects was derived from (rewire_agentforce.tools_block_sha256); the hosted rewire refuses up when it is not the current block's

finding.description: the STATELESS finding, with the search that established it, or null when ungoverned

inputs.description: C2: every input the agent's source accepts (scripts/agent_inventory.py), modelled by a matching agent.io.input part or agent.io.channels entry, or waived with a typed reason the agent never receives it. `init` copies the reader's entries; `validate` re-reads the source and refuses one unaccounted (input_channel_unaccounted)

waived.description: required with waived: why the AGENT never receives this input (bench_manifest.WAIVER_BECAUSE). What the harness drives or chooses is never a reason (input_channel_unaccounted)

cite.description: <path>:<line> in the agent's own files (never plurai_sim/) that shows it; not needed with operator_answer:<id>

reaches.description: <path>:<line> (what) where the reader saw it steer the agent (a branch, the prompt): never transport_only / harness_session_state / internal_field

sent_by.description: <path>:<line> of an in-repo caller that sends it: never not_reachable_in_production

channel.description: the agent.io.channels name that models it, when its name and field differ from this entry's name

production_tools.description: C3: the agent's tools under its production defaults (every capability switch at its default) = static ∪ live, copied from artifacts/agent_inventory.json. The harness never narrows it: a tool missing from the map or the live set needs a harness.capability_overrides entry naming its switch (production_tool_dropped); a tool the bench carries that C3 does not account for is production_inventory_incomplete

loader.description: <path>:<line> where the tool set is assembled; null when the reader found no assembly site (never a synthesized cite)

static.description: the tools the source defines at its production defaults (the reader's static read)

live.description: the tools the setup smoke enumerated with every switch at its production default (`agent_inventory.py record-live`); absent until enumerated. An empty list is a recorded tool-less enumeration only with `live_enumerated_by`

live_enumerated_by.description: <path>:<line> of the call that built the live list (`record-live --enumerated-by`): what makes `live: []` a recorded state rather than an unrecorded one

dynamic.description: registrars whose tool names exist only at run time (a computed name, an installed tool class the reader could not read): production_inventory_incomplete until `live` is recorded

backends.description: installed tool classes the agent's own code calls (never handed to a model): a bench entry mocking one is no production tool

pauses.description: <path>:<line> where the agent stops for the user's answer (interrupt, a mid-turn Command(goto=END)): a card render_actions must declare (input_scope_cut)

inventory_sha256.description: agent_inventory.digest of artifacts/agent_inventory.json — the ONE inventory the validator, the map and lint_prd read

not_loaded.description: C11: tools the reader counted that the production default does not load, typed. A world precondition is never a reason: the scan seeds it

switch.description: default_off_switch: a production_tools.switches[].switch whose default is OFF

selector.description: provider_variant: the switch choosing the variant; covered per value or answered in harness.capability_overrides

surface.description: separate_surface: <path>:<line> of the other entry point, inside agent_root and outside bench_overlay

overridden_by.description: <path>:<line> of an enable-all path defaulting ON, so a class default OFF is no off switch

kind.description: a mode selector: a payload field choosing between the task types the production host registers; its production default is every value

field.description: selector: the payload key the agent compares

values.description: selector: every value the production host offers, each cited at its registration

selects.description: selector: value -> the inputs only that value's branch reaches (`*` = a branch on any other value)

language.description: the harness is always simulate.py on the Python SDK; a non-Python agent runs behind it in a bridge child (harness.bridge)

bridge.description: present when the workdir holds bridge/bridge.map.json: simulate.py drives the agent in its own runtime through a bridge child (skills/simulation-setup-bridge/references/bridge-contract.md); derived from the files on every init

provider.description: provider whose key the agent needs at run time (name only, never the key)

env_file.description: the env file the harness loads, relative to the agent module or absolute (default: the nearest .env up to the repository top); only key NAMES are checked for presence

provider_env.description: env var names that carry the agent provider key; presence only is ever checked

model_env.description: the env var that selects the agent's main model at run time; a provider-prefixed value (<provider>/<model> or <provider>:<model>) decides which provider key is checked, otherwise `provider` (the code's default model) does. The value is never recorded

reason.description: required with mode unsupported: the agent's conversation lives in a session the harness cannot write (a hosted session that opens empty, or a bridge entry with no seed export)

evidence.description: required with mode unsupported: <path>:<line> of the refusal

resume.description: whether seed_state replays a resume seed (dialog benches). A fresh init writes {mode: replay}, or the bridge map's {mode: unsupported} when its entry cannot seed; a refresh never adds it, so its absence marks a manifest that predates the field

capability_overrides.description: a capability switch the harness sets away from its production default, each on an operator answer naming it; never a harness_differs fact. The tools that switch gates may then be absent from the map and the live set

tools.description: the tools it switches off, when the reader found no gates for the switch

answer_id.description: the operator answer that disabled it: the ask's gate, as the run driver record files it

route_smoke.description: the command that proves the host-side route, run before any paid turn

tool_interception.description: where the mocked tools are intercepted; absent means `harness`. `agent_host`: the agent's own host calls the mock, so the harness wraps nothing and its local checks record not_run

evidence.description: <path>:<line> of the agent's own file that declares it; that line names it

probe.description: kind: executable only, with probe_evidence — an argv (no shell) running the invocation that line documents, headed by the program itself or by the agent's own route to it, with the line's own words before a route, its options and its operands (each the line's word or a host_probes/ fixture), never the program alone; `{agent}/<path>` names the agent's own file, shown on the line; a fixture it reads ships in plurai_sim/host_probes/. Run where the agent runs the program; a non-zero exit is `fails_sandboxed` or `broken`, by where it ran

probe_evidence.description: required with probe — <path>:<line> of the agent's own file documenting the invocation the probe runs; that line names the requirement

install.description: with install_evidence — the command the agent's own install docs give for it, verbatim (never one you write); run-gate prints it, in one copy-paste block, for a requirement measured missing; nothing runs it

install_evidence.description: required with install — <path>:<line> of the agent's own install docs carrying that command verbatim

host_requirements.description: what the agent's own files declare it needs on this host outside its interpreter's in-process imports; run-gate resolves each one live where the agent uses it (present / missing / fails_sandboxed / broken / unverified / not checked — no probe is unverified); a measured gap (missing / broken / fails_sandboxed) is NOT RUNNABLE until the plugin repairs it or overrules its finding, and an unmeasured one ships with its finding

agent_root.description: C11: the root of the agent's upstream tree, relative to the repository root ('.' for all of it): a cite outside it is a harness choice

bench_overlay.description: C11: files inside agent_root git says are not the customer's (untracked/modified, or changed with the harness); a cite into one is a harness choice that needs an operator-answered harness.capability_overrides

suffixes.description: EXTRA suffixes beyond the checker's default set

unsandboxed.description: the declared programs (harness.host_requirements, kind: executable) the operator let run outside the Bash sandbox; only `granted` lets any out. A granted program runs outside the sandbox, with full read, write and network access to the machine and any arguments, and a Bash command leaves the sandbox only when every command in it is a granted program

checks.description: every check the runner may execute; each names the manifest field paths it VERIFIES. A field no check verifies is reported declared_only.

verifies.description: JSON-pointer-ish field paths, e.g. surfaces.render_actions, surfaces.tools[get_order]

witnesses.description: fields this check proves by the runtime witness it returns: agent.entry for a builtin smoke (a witness-only field, refused in any verifies), surfaces.tools[<name>] of a mocked tool for mock_contract. Checked by bench_manifest.py

script.description: path relative to $WORKDIR for python/node/bash runners

requires.description: prerequisites; a missing one yields not_run with that reason, never a fabricated result. corpus_roots empty and seeded_world absent (no .seed_probe_world.json, a null one, or no seed_state) are not_applicable

policy.description: always: every scan. on_change: re-run when derived_from hash or script hash moved, else reused. on_mode: run only when mode_rule holds

mode_rule.description: for policy on_mode, e.g. agent.dispatch_shape == dialog

feeds.description: typed-fact ids this check's observation supports (probe_report P-ids or fact subjects)

credentials.description: kind live: the environment variable NAMES the service's client signs in with that have no working default (never a value); names the missing ones when the check fails

blocking.description: a failed/not_run blocking check turns the hand-off into the failure hand-off

coverage_holes.description: INTERNAL ONLY, never on a customer artifact: production behaviour the harness accepts it does not run. Every `seam: tool_body` mock's `skipped_code` cite is one (`mechanism: seam:tool_body:<tool>`, derived by `init`); a gap the suite accepts is added with `bench_manifest.py coverage-hole`, never as a loop-log note

mechanism.description: what does not run: `seam:tool_body:<tool>`, or the guard / middleware / path the gap is in

source.description: `<path>:<line>` (or `<path>:<start>-<end>`) of the agent code that does not run

reason.description: why it is accepted: the tool_body `seam_reason`, or the suite's ruling
